question: Which of the following best describes the author’s tone?
solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ***A) The tone of the passage is detailed and explores the elements of hard work and smart work through comparative analysis.***

 
 
• This **indicates** that the author is breaking down the concepts thoughtfully and providing an analytical perspective on their effectiveness.
 
 
 
• ***B) An assertive tone demands strong conviction and directive language which the passage does not exhibit.***
 
 
• This **cannot be inferred** from the passage as it lacks prescriptive or commanding language.
 
 
 
• ***C) The tone is not reflective as it doesn’t delve into personal reflections or contemplative musings.***
 
 
• The passage focuses on presenting information and analysis rather than personal introspection.
 
 
 
• ***D) The casual tone is often informal and relaxed which is not the case in this passage.***
 
 
• The passage maintains a formal and structured approach in discussing the topic.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3: Analytical**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: Assertive** - Incorrect because the passage does not have a directive or commanding tone.
 
• **Option 2: Reflective** - Incorrect because the passage does not include personal reflections.
 
• **Option 4: Casual** - Incorrect because the passage is formal and structured in its examination.
